reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Gary & his team did another excellent job for us decorating the exterior of our house and doing additional jobs inside… I have no hesitation in recommending this outstanding company for their workmanship and professionalism, as well as their congeniality and adaptability.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Thank you Gary & your team for the hard work you put into decorating our new home. As we wanted our whole house decorated it was hard finding someone to trust but you didn't let us down…
items.label: Which? review

items.text: We hired Gary to undertake a full external & internal decoration of the house including remedial building work. He and his team not only did a first class job but also went out of their way to make our lives tolerable during the 6 weeks they were working…
